newsitem.title: USA: CME Feeders rally to new highs on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CME Feeders rally to new highs on fund buying.

text.p: CME feeder cattle futures rallied to new contract highs across the board on fund buying and scattered buy stops, traders said.

Early profit taking pressure lacked follow through and prices moved up on the continued commercial and fund support. Charts point up and cash feeder markets continue to advance and are at 22-month highs, they said.
Feeders were 0.900 to 0.275 cent higher, with August up most at 80.400 cents a lb, a new contract high.
